title: st2110-40: Add new dissector for SMPTE ST2110-40
description:
Introduce a new native dissector for ST2110-40, heavily derived from NEOAdvancedTechnology's Lua dissector authored by Thomas Edwards thomas.edwards@disney.com (under GPLv2 and later)

The approach of the original Lua dissector was split out into the core packetization and the ST291 parsing/dissection, so that the dissection code for the actual VANC packets can be shared with other formats such as SMPTE ST2038 (VANC over MPEG-TS)

This patch includes parsing/dissection for the following:

* ST12-2 (SMPTE timecodes within VANC)
* ST334-2 (CEA-708 Closed Captions within VANC)
* ST2010 (SCTE-104 within VANC) ST2016-3 (Active Format Description within VANC)
* ST2031 (VBI within VANC) OP47/RDD8 (teletext within VANC)

Some of these were derived from the the Lua dissector (with numerous bug fixes/improvements). Some were implemented from scratch.

I have sample streams available under the GPL, which I will upload to the Wiki as I can get the permissions worked out.

This MR supercedes MR 26394, taking into account comments from @AndersBroman

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2

changes_data.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+/* packet-smpte-291-vanc.h
+ * Shared SMPTE ST 291 ancillary-data fields and subdissector table.
+ *
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+ */
+
+#ifndef __PACKET_SMPTE_291_VANC_H__
+#define __PACKET_SMPTE_291_VANC_H__
+
+#include <epan/packet.h>
+
+/*
+ * Context passed by an ST 291 ANC/VANC transport to a DID/SDID subdissector.
+ * The interface is transport-independent and is shared by transports such as
+ * ST 2110-40 and ST 2038.
+ * top_tree lets an application payload promote its decode to packet level,
+ * while payload_index uniquely identifies this ANC payload within the frame.
+ */
+typedef struct {
+    proto_tree *top_tree;
+    uint32_t payload_index;
+} st291_vanc_dissector_data_t;
+
+dissector_table_t st291_get_did_sdid_table(void);
+
+proto_item *st291_tree_add_did(proto_tree *tree, tvbuff_t *tvb,
+                               int offset, int length, uint8_t did);
+proto_item *st291_tree_add_sdid(proto_tree *tree, tvbuff_t *tvb,
+                                int offset, int length, uint8_t did, uint8_t sdid);
+proto_item *st291_tree_add_dbn(proto_tree *tree, tvbuff_t *tvb,
+                               int offset, int length, uint8_t dbn);
+void st291_append_packet_description(proto_item *item, uint8_t did,
+                                     uint8_t sdid_or_dbn);
+
+#endif /* __PACKET_SMPTE_291_VANC_H__ */

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+#
+# Wireshark tests
+#
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+#
+
+'''SMPTE ST 2110-40 tests'''
+
+import subprocess
+
+class TestSt2110_40:
+
+    def test_st2110_40_decode_as(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((
+            cmd_tshark,
+            '-r', capture_file('st2110-40.pcap.gz'),
+
+            # The capture contains RTP on UDP port 5000,
+            # but has no signaling identifying it as RTP.
+            '-d', 'udp.port==5000,rtp',
+            '-d', 'udp.port==5010,rtp',
+            '-d', 'udp.port==1234,rtp',
+            '-d', 'udp.port==20000,rtp',
+
+            # RTP payload type 100 is dynamic.  The capture has no SDP
+            # identifying PT 100 as ST 2110-40, so explicitly decode it.
+            '-d', 'rtp.pt==100,st2110_40',
+
+            '-Y', 'st2110_40',
+
+            '-T', 'fields',
+            '-e', 'frame.number',
+            '-e', 'rtp.p_type',
+            '-e', 'st291.did',
+            '-e', 'st291.sdid',
+            '-e', 'st12_2.timecode',
+        ),
+        encoding='utf-8',
+        env=test_env)
+
+        assert stdout == (
+            '1\t100\t\t\t\n'
+            '2\t100\t0x60\t0x60\t16:16:10;12\n'
+            '3\t100\t0x41\t0x05\t\n'
+            '4\t100\t0x61\t0x01\t\n'
+            '5\t100\t0x60,0x61,0x60\t0x60,0x01,0x60\t01:04:33;23,01:04:33;23\n'
+            '6\t100\t0x61\t0x01\t\n'
+            '7\t100\t0x60,0x53,0x60,0x43\t0x60,0x02,0x60,0x02\t00:00:50:19,00:00:50:19\n'
+        )
